name: Handel
tagline: Finds the musical relatives of a track, then helps you work them into something new.
description: Capture whatever is playing on your computer, or hand it a clip, and it goes looking for songs that share that track's DNA - similar mood, structure, or lineage - then helps you fold what it finds into writing, arranging, or studying the piece.
author: monomyth
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
